name: default
note: THE DEFAULT LOOK, and it is deliberately the vawe brand: white-first with one cobalt accent, mirroring the real site (site/app/globals.css). `default` is the name every author reaches for by habit, so it must not be a palette that belongs to nobody - it used to hold mono+lime, which is why films kept shipping in a colour no site of ours uses. The neutral starting point for a fork or a new brand kit now lives in themes/neutral.json. This file MIRRORS themes/vawe.json and lib-test fails if the two palettes drift apart.

motion._exitRatio: the house default: half, which is the middle of the band the five existing themes already use. Asymmetric timing: an entrance is an introduction, an exit is over (docs/CRAFT/MOTION-STANDARDS.md).
